questions.stem: What is the functional group in carboxylic acids?
questions.explanation: The functional group in carboxylic acids is the carboxyl group (-COOH), which contains both a C=O (carbonyl) and -OH (hydroxyl). The hydrogen in -COOH can dissociate to give H+, which is what makes carboxylic acids acidic.

questions.stem: When ethanoic acid reacts with magnesium, the products are:
questions.explanation: Carboxylic acids react with metals in the same way as other acids: acid + metal -> salt + hydrogen. Ethanoic acid + magnesium -> magnesium ethanoate + hydrogen: 2CH3COOH + Mg -> (CH3COO)2Mg + H2. Fizzing is observed as hydrogen gas is produced.
